items.title: Global NEV Sales Rise 7.6% YoY in 3Q26 as BEV and PHEV Market Trends Diverge, Says TrendForce
items.lead: TrendForce’s latest research reveals that global sales of NEVs, including BEVs, PHEVs, and FCVs, reached 5.79 million units in the third quarter of 2026, up 7.6% YoY. When HEVs are also included, the four vehicle categories collectively accounted for a record 35.2% of global automotive sales during the quarter.

items.title: Cuts to Chinese CSP Demand Weigh on Price Outlook, Slowing Memory Industry Revenue Growth in 2027, Says TrendForce
items.lead: TrendForce’s latest memory industry research indicates that Chinese CSPs have reduced their 2027 memory orders, putting downward pressure on the industry’s price outlook. The NAND Flash market is expected to enter a downward pricing cycle as supply continues to expand, prompting TrendForce to lower its 2027 NAND Flash revenue forecast to approximately US$419.3 billion.

items.title: AI Demand Squeezes Glass Fiber Cloth Supply and Drives Up PCB Prices, Raising COB/SMD LED Display Costs by 2% QoQ in 4Q26, Says TrendForce
items.lead: TrendForce’s latest quarterly report, “LED Display Module Quarterly Cost and Market Analysis,” reveals that PCB cost increases in the fourth quarter of 2026 have driven up manufacturing costs for COB and SMD LED displays. Using P1.25 products (with a 1.25 mm pixel pitch) as an example, overall bill-of-materials (BOM) costs for COB and SMD LED displays rose about 2% QoQ, continuing the upward trend from the third quarter. In contrast, falling LED package prices reduced BOM costs for P1.25 MiP LED displays by about 4% QoQ.

items.title: NAND Flash Prices Set to Decline in 2027 as Chinese CSP Order Cuts Outweigh North American Demand Growth, Says TrendForce
items.lead: TrendForce’s latest memory industry research indicates that the global NAND Flash market is expected to see a reversal in supply-demand dynamics in 2027. With supply set to grow rapidly, substantial cuts to enterprise SSD orders from Chinese CSPs—coupled with a potential further contraction in consumer electronics demand—are expected to exacerbate oversupply.

items.title: Global OLED Monitor Shipments Double YoY in 3Q26 as Rankings Shift Dramatically Among Top Five Brands, Says TrendForce
items.lead: Global OLED monitor shipments maintained strong momentum in the third quarter of 2026, rising 13% QoQ and doubling compared with the same period in 2025, according to TrendForce’s latest research. Growth was driven not only by continued product launches from major brands, which helped boost shipment volumes, but also by ample upstream panel supply. The latter has enabled second-tier and emerging brands to significantly expand their shipments.
